candidateDedup.encoding: Collapse all frozen generic setups on the same key; retain isBreakout/isPullback/isSweep multi-hot flags.
candidateDedup.executionRepresentative: The first generated candidate is used only for the frozen trigger_close plan builder; trigger_close plan geometry is independent of setup_level.

splitPurity.fit: signal and worst-case frozen baseline exit must both be strictly before 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z.
splitPurity.development: signal and worst-case frozen baseline exit must both be strictly before 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z.

addedFeatureDefinitions.efficiency20: abs(close-close[-20]) / sum(abs(close[j]-close[j-1])) across the last 20 completed intervals; NaN if denominator zero.
addedFeatureDefinitions.volume_z20: (signal-bar volume - mean of previous 20 completed volumes) / std(previous 20); NaN when volume unavailable/zero-variance.
addedFeatureDefinitions.vix_change5: latest causally available completed-daily VIX close/close[-5]-1.
addedFeatureDefinitions.spx_return5: latest causally available completed-daily S&P500 close/close[-5]-1.
addedFeatureDefinitions.dxy_return5: latest causally available completed-daily DXY close/close[-5]-1.
addedFeatureDefinitions.btc_return5: latest causally available completed-daily BTC close/close[-5]-1.

inheritedFeatures: All IFE1 causal features use the exact IFE1 definitions; daily context availability remains timestamp + 1 UTC day.

targetConstruction.horizon: 48 evaluated bars on 1h; 30 evaluated bars on 4h, bounded inside fit/development split.
targetConstruction.signalAtr: ATR14 known on completed signal bar.
targetConstruction.goodOpportunity: From actual entry, +1.5*signalATR favorable barrier must occur before -1.0*signalATR adverse barrier; adverse barrier wins same-bar ambiguity.
targetConstruction.mfeAtr: Maximum favorable excursion from actual entry / signalATR across horizon.
targetConstruction.maeAtr: Maximum adverse excursion from actual entry / signalATR across horizon.

preprocessing.fitOnly: Preprocessor fitted on IFE2 fit window only.

modelSemantics.pGoodScore: Logistic classifier score for goodOpportunity; not calibrated probability.
modelSemantics.pTailLossScore: Logistic classifier score for tailLoss; not calibrated probability.

causalAdaptiveThreshold.fitHistory: For each marketFamily, initialize score history with all fit-window qualityScore values after the four frozen models are fitted.
causalAdaptiveThreshold.developmentOrdering: Sort development candidates by entryUtc. All candidates sharing the same entryUtc are evaluated against histories containing only fit scores plus scores from strictly earlier development timestamps.
causalAdaptiveThreshold.threshold: 85th percentile of same-market-family history when at least 200 history rows exist.
causalAdaptiveThreshold.historyUpdate: After decisions at a timestamp are frozen, append all candidate scores from that timestamp to their market-family histories. Realized outcomes are never used.

evaluation.baseOutcome: Frozen base-cost netR of selected candidates.
evaluation.stressOutcome: Frozen stress-cost netR of selected candidates.
evaluation.recall: Selected goodOpportunity count / all eligible development goodOpportunity count.
evaluation.positiveMonth: UTC signal-month sum of selected netR >0.
evaluation.concentration: Max positive family total netR / sum of positive family total netR.

bootstrap: Hierarchical symbol/timeframe resampling with circular candidate blocks, using parent-lock iterations/seed/block length.
forbidden: No change to added/inherited features after outcomes.
No percentile or hard-gate change after outcomes.
No validation/holdout access unless every development gate passes.
